newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended weaker, marking the third straight session of declines, and extending a price drop which has been largely unbroken since March 5.
Traders noted German Bunds also were softer.
Treasuries were also lower after U.S. consumer prices.

"This morning we were in a relatively narrow trading range, then in the afternoon, there was a large seller in the (Confederate bonds with maturities of) 2006, 2007 and 2008," one trader said. From time to time we had the feeling that a rebound is likely, especially in the Bund, but at the end, the situation was different. It doesn't look so rosy," he said.
U.S. February consumer prices showed a 0.3 percent rise in February in the overall rate compared with analysts' forecasts for a 0.2 percent rise.
The Swiss market awaits a new Treasury auction next week.
June Comi medium-term bond down 18 at 111.15
June Euro Swiss francs down five at 98.11.
